question.text: The independent valuer appointed for valuation of a Category III AIF's investments must NOT be:

answer.text: A Registered Valuer under Companies Act Section 247
An associate of the manager, sponsor, or trustee of the AIF

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the chapter: 'The independent valuer shall not be an associate of manager or sponsor or trustee of the AIF.' This ensures independence. The Trap: Options A, C, D are all ACCEPTABLE profiles. The chapter bars only association with manager/sponsor/trustee. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A/B/C/D all test the independence rule identically. Manager's Pro-Tip: Even apparent 'not-associate' relationships (common directors, shared offices, related-party vendor contracts) can be flagged by SEBI inspectors - maintain a conflicts-register signed annually by the chosen valuer.
